_comment: Universe for the Phase 1 widened-universe test. Tokens are resolved automatically at fetch time from Angel One's public scrip master, so only the trading symbol is listed here. VERIFY this list against the current NSE Nifty 50 constituents before relying on it - index membership changes at semi-annual reviews, and any name that has been removed introduces survivorship bias. fetch_universe.py reports any symbol it cannot resolve.
